sample_exact.persistent_theme: same theme and direction on at least 3 trading days with at least 2 analysts
sample_exact.catalyst_status: date_anchor <= period_end is realized; future or unparseable dates are pending
sample_exact.sellside_forwarding: background only and excluded from analyst consensus

not_identifiable_from_sample: per-analyst weight values and approval history
source-quality checker prompts and model versions
complete evidence payloads behind every aggregate
unique implementation of theme trend confidence

kss_equivalent_v1.theme_strength: sum((stance_score / 2) * analyst_weight * conviction_weight) per instrument and theme
kss_equivalent_v1.trend: second-half daily theme-strength mean minus first-half mean with snapshot-seeded bootstrap interval

differences: The sample states that temperature is analyst-weight and conviction weighted, but does not disclose either mapping.
The sample chart labels a visual scale from -2 to +2 while published daily values are near zero; KSS normalizes the deterministic metric to [-1, 1].
KSS labels temperature, theme strength, and trend as kss_equivalent rather than sample_exact.
KSS removes action, position, target-price, and personalized trading outputs from the method contract.
